summary: RFID tire tags are ruggedized UHF transponders designed to be embedded into the tire rubber during manufacturing or patched onto the inner liner after production. They provide permanent tire identification throughout the entire lifecycle — from factory through distribution, fleet operation, retreading and end-of-life recycling.
